snippet.title: ALATURKA - Pre-Alpha Gameplay
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4226560?utm_source=bufuakgames&utm_medium=youtube&utm_content=prealphagameplay

I spent the last year building ALATURKA, a retro open-world game set in Istanbul, entirely on livestreams.

This is 2 minutes of uncut gameplay showing the current state of the driving physics and city atmosphere. I recently optimized the crowd system to make the city feel more alive.

No cinematic tricks. Just the game.

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/tbSEDnftPA
